issues.title: CouchDb not updating for live wargame
issues.body:
I had some issues with the CouchDb backed in today's wargame. Well, we couldn't play the game - because the wargame wouldn't update.

It _looks like_ this is the issue.

**Setup:** CouchDb has a wargame. It just has one document `initial_wargame` - this is typical of un-initialised wargame, during design phase.
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/181596324-92f25340-bac6-49f2-b894-18071cb379b8.png)

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/181596610-17b123f9-a9c9-49ed-8fef-b3221fc36979.png)

We make an admin edit, save it, re-load the wargame, and we see our change.

![screencast](https://i.gyazo.com/e7237574c212d5d660d492eacdd9c753.gif)

(you can mangle this data, I have safe copy).

If we then `initiate` wargame, when we make changes - each change should be produced as a new document.  They are produced as new documents, but the Serge Admin pages are still loading the `initial_wargame` document, and trying to view/edit that document.


https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/181598317-ec740b62-ea5c-4215-935e-640a3c15d60a.mp4



![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/181597629-6ef72dae-9815-4324-8272-41a24643f3f9.png)

I _think_ this is an issue with the `latest` API end-point.  

So, I think this is the problem:
* Admin pages isn't retrieving latest document for display. It's retrieving `initial_wargame` - and modifying that
* Admin pages isn't retrieving latest document when making a change. (I _guess_ admin gets most recent and applies change to it, rather than using the in-memory one).  It's retrieving `initial_wargame` - and modifying that

comments.body: With hindsight, I think the issue here was that client was stopping listening.  It seems ok now.
